comments: [BKUHJCNA]: 819. According to Las chen, he was a 'Phan yul rgyal lha khang pa. Later, when he was holding the grwa tshang of sGros snying at gSang phu, he followed rGyal tshab's (ID: 6006) way of explaining phar tshad (rgyal tshab rin po che'i phar tshad kyi bshad sgros legs par bzung).
